crossRefs.note: Now David was sitting between the two gates; and the watchman went up to the roof of the gate to the wall, and lifted…
and a spirit of justice to him who sits in judgment, and strength to those who turn back the battle at the gate.
David counted the people who were with him, and set captains of thousands and captains of hundreds over them.
The lords of the Philistines passed on by hundreds and by thousands; and David and his men passed on in the rear with…

translations.web: The king said to them, “I will do what seems best to you.” The king stood beside the gate, and all the people went out by hundreds and by thousands.
translations.bsb: “I will do whatever seems best to you,” the king replied. So he stood beside the gate, while all the troops marched out by hundreds and by thousands.
translations.kjv: And the king said unto them, What seemeth you best I will do. And the king stood by the gate side, and all the people came out by hundreds and by thousands.
translations.asv: And the king said unto them, What seemeth you best I will do. And the king stood by the gate-side, and all the people went out by hundreds and by thousands.
